column3: Beginning of sight-seeing tour
...Are you really okay...?
Don't you trust me?
T-That's not what I mean...
Grandpa, I'm really worried, you know?
Grandma, you're the one who greatly worries me.
Try not to get mixed up with another school's group and end up lost for me please?
Eeeh? I wouldn't do such a thing! Geez...
There's no problem. You're with me anyway.
Eh? K-Kyou-chan?
I'll be counting on you if anything were to happen to me, Manami.
N-Nothing should happen in the first place～
Haha, just joking.
Geez... Stupid Kyou-chan.
Well then, shall we go?
Where to?
Didn't you read the school trip's handbook?
Ah, that's right. You just passed it to me yesterday.
You didn't read it...
It's alright since you've read it.
Yes, I'll lead the way. I really looked forward to this... Look!
Manami took out a worn out "School trip handbook".
How many years ago did you get that?
This year.
You've read it way too many times.
I've been looking forward to this... Teeheehee.
How many years has it been since we went on a trip together?
It's been since the trip in middle school, so about 3 years.
With her way of talking, it disturbs me that it makes me think it was 20 years ago.
It's free time for individual groups now.
Oh yeah, the homeroom teacher said something about that.
...Then, who are the members of my group?
Who's in it...?
I do remember that I'm in the same group as Manami...
Probably includes Akagi as well... How many more should there be?
The others have left already.
Why?
As long as there is no problem getting together at the end of the day, Akagi-kun suggests that we all go our way.
So it's Akagi's work...
He's probably suspicious about my relationship with Manami.
So that's why he acted tactfully.
...What a nosy bastard.
A mail? I looked at the screen---
...How rare.
The name "Kirino" lit up.
What does she want now.
What's wrong, Kyou-chan?
A mail from my sister.
Oh, heehee... You seem delighted.
Of course not.
I calmly replied to her and took a look at the mail.
Buy the whole set of 【Regional Edition Meruru】.
【Regional Edition Meruru】?
What did Kirino-chan say?
She told me to bring local souvenirs back.
Tch... Seriously, don't mail me for that kind of useless stuff.
...Hihihi.
...? What are you laughing for?
Nothing～
Where shall we start touring?
Well then, where should we go?
Since time is limited, we can't go to that many places...
Since we came to Kyoto,
Kiyomizu-dera is a given, right?
Thank you.
Eh?
You remembered where I wanted to go.
...Heh.
'Kay, let's go.
I seriously get the feeling we're in Kyoto, don't you?
Yeah. It's crowded... We can't even move about.
Around us, our school trip formed one line. People into the fad of "Power Spot Touring" were jamming up the place.
I-If I'm correct... the marriage waterfall is this way....
Hey, don't panic and fall, okay?
And so I warned her, but...
Eh?
The one about to fall was, in fact, me.
The wave of people pushed against my back and-
...U-, wah
Before I could notice, Manami was caught between my arms.
S-Sorry!
No... There's no problem...
A typical galge development.
In this kind of situation... I couldn't split off even if I wanted to.
I'm feeling something pushing against my elbow...
*gulp*
Kyou-chan...
I-It can't be... Can she read my mind...?
I can tell if I see your face.
A-Anyway, let's move!
Desperately trying to change the subject.
It really was crowded...
Sure was...
There was an awkward atmosphere between us...
S-Seems like we can't get to the marriage waterfall.
Yes, it can't be helped...
Are you sure? You wanted to try it, didn't you?
It's okay, really.
Really?
Yes. Let's go, Kyou-chan.
Then we left Kiyomizu-dera.
Changing her mind suddenly... I can't understand her.
Do you know about a Regional Edition Meruru?
Regional Edition Meruru?
Trying not to be mistaken for a pervert as well as not tarnishing my sister's dignity, I answer vaguely.
So that's the case. Let's look for it then. Hmm... We'll probably find out if we ask at the souvenir store?
Manami started looking around aimlessly.
Kyou-chan, look over there!
In the direction Manami pointed was a poster that said "Limited Edition!! Regional Edition Meruru, only at Shinkyougoku!"
So it really does exist.
Shinkyougoku it is. Kyou-chan, let's go there first, shall we?
Yeah... I'm kinda sorry. I'm sure there's other places you want to go, right?
Well then, let's walk around Shinkyougoku after buying the souvenir for Kirino-chan.
Right, let's do that.
We set off to Shinkyougoku to buy those "Regional Edition Meruru" souvenirs.
D-Do you really need to buy so many..?
Yeah... She asked for the whole set...
But... as many as the many popular shrines in Tokyo?
That girl, she better be grateful to me...
As my purse became lighter, my body leaned heavily under both the Meruru souvenirs and a bottomless exhaustion.
...Hmm.
Are you still hesitating...? There's plenty of time, so take your time.
I feel like there are other places I must go...
I can't recall, or maybe I don't want to...
I just couldn't recall where.
...But, what would Manami think of me if I were to mention this?
Anyway, do you know a renowned shop that sells oil absorbing sheets?
Eh?
It seems like it's really good and someone asked me to buy some as souvenirs.
If that's the case, shouldn't it be in the area of Gion?
Oh, you really know a lot.
Ehehe, I was looking forward to it, so I've looked into a lot of things...
Are you going to buy that for Kirino-chan?
Nope, it's a souvenir for Ayase.
Oooh～
W-What's wrong?
Ayase-chan was rather angry at Kyou-chan before... Have you two reconciled?
That girl is always angry at me.
For various reasons. I can't explain in detail.
Well, could it be...
...that you scattered ero-books in front of Ayase-chan,
Told her that it's the proof of your love with Kirino while showing off said books to her,
Embraced Kirino-chan and shouted "I love my little sister!"?
-Why do you know about that?!
I heard it from her.
Ugh.
That's what it was... Before I even realized, the relationship between Manami and Ayase has become pretty good.
This is troublesome.
Even about Kyou-chan trying to get Ayase-chan to wear that lewd dress-up.
Also when you did lewd things to a game character that looked just like Ayase-chan.
Even instigating Ayase-chan to say some embarrassing lines.
I've heard everything from her.
Hahaha, what are you saying, Manami.
Isn't it obvious that it's all a misunderstanding on her part?
Eh... Really?
Of course.
B-But...
Look at those eyes... Do you not believe me?
Hmm... However, when I consider "Kyou-chan's voice".
What do you mean by "voice"?
The voice that is recorded in Ayase-chan's mobile phone.
What did... you say...?
...It can't be.
Prepare yourself, listen carefully, I...
love my little sisteeeeeeerrrrr-
It can't be, she recorded it...?
I was so shaken I started having cold sweat.
Crap...
It's really bad this time, there's a possibility that everything I've said to Ayase has been recorded...!
Anyway, Kyou-chan? You're acting too childish towards Ayase-chan.
Eh?
If you're interested in Ayase-chan, you need to act properly like a senior should.
...I-It's not like that!
Certainly, Ayase is very cute and she's my type... But it's not like I consider her as a love interest.
I guess...?
E-Enough of that. Hurry up, let's go.
...I managed to deceive my way through that, and made my way to Gion.
Oh yeah, have you heard of a company called "Heian Animation"?
What is that?
Even though Manami looks like she's knowledgeable about Kyoto, she hasn't heard of a company called "Heian Animation"
Do you want to go there?
It's not that I want to but...
Understood! I'll go ask at the counter!
As said, Manami walked towards the counter.
That girl's really enthusiastic.
After talking for a while at the counter, Manami returned...
That company is apparently in Kyoto district.
Oh.
But, seems like it's closed for today.
Closed... Can't be helped then.
Sorry.
There's no need for you to apologize.
Let's go somewhere else.
Where to?
With Saori's face surfacing in my mind, I ponder for a while...
Let's go to Animate's Kyoto branch.
Eeeeeh.
This should work.
I held up my "Kyoto Limited Edition Robot Model Plastic Figure" which I bought from Mate's Kyoto branch and nodded with confidence.
Beside me is of course Manami.
So you like plastic models?
No, it's a souvenir. There's... someone who likes this kind of thing.
Is it someone I know?
Haven't you met that person?
She's like Kuroneko, a mutual friend of Kirino and me. We met about a year ago.
Eh, are you guys close?
Yeah!
That's right. When you were buying the souvenirs, you seemed really happy.
Hehe, yeah.
That's right, Saori is, to me... an important friend.
D-Damn it... if only I knew Kyoto better...
Guess there's no helping it, you looked busy.
The figure of a black gothic lolita came up to my mind.
K-Kuroneko... What did she say again?
I think it's a curse or something...
Hmmm, do you know about Abe no Seimei?
Of course I know about him.
Abe no Seimei is the exorcist that protected Kyoto during the Heian period.
E-Exorcist?
Records now show that the Shinto Priest had immense powers.
He used this power to exterminate the demons nesting around and in Kyoto.
Let's go and take a look at the Seimei Shrine!
This is the Seimei Shrine.
Hm? I've often seen those marks here and there...
It's called a pentagram. It's a seal Abe no Seimei used.
No matter how noble this symbol is, all I can see it as is the "☆" from "Stardust ☆ Witch Meruru".
It's like their curses were gnawing at me...
Excuse me, could you please give me this pentagram?
Is it a souvenir for Kuroneko-san?
That's right. She sent me a mail asking for it.
It seems like Kuroneko-san and Kyou-chan are getting along pretty well.
I-Is that so?
Yeah, could it be that... you two are dating?
No no, we aren't.
Reallyyy? Fufufu... suspicious～
It's not!
I managed to repel Manami's inquiry but...
My mind is in a mess.
..."A curse"...
I won't "dispel" my curse until my wish is fulfilled.
At that time, I was "cursed" by Kuroneko's kiss.
A curse so strong that it's still entwined around my heart, eroding it.
Maybe Abe no Seimei would've been able to undo this curse.
Staring at the pentagram I just bought... I casually put it in my pocket.
The blush on my face, however, didn't disappear so easily.
There's nowhere you want to go?
Well, nope.
Ok. Then let's ride that!
Manami said while pointing at the famous tour bus which goes around Kyoto.
Today, I'll guide you through Kyoto all day.
--Yeah, I'll leave it to you.
I've made up my mind. Today I'll spend my time doing some sightseeing with Manami.
